title: Recurring errors across games

D0.outcome: Explains that a recurring error is a pattern only if it appears across several games.

D1.outcome: From his ledger, finds the error type that occurs in at least three of ten games.

D2.outcome: States a pattern with its sample size, and separates a process pattern from a knowledge pattern.

D3.outcome: Tests a pattern with a targeted position set and reports the result.

misconceptions: A bad game is a pattern.
conditions: Evidence across games, with sample size.
contrasts: One bad game labelled a pattern.
A pattern from a small sample treated as a trait.
Random noise in a run of games.
